reviews.x: I've had an obsession with gels with my time off from work these past months and I wanted to try this color changing polish. It comes with designs and while the color itself is dark it does change. I am enjoying trying the designs but man it does take practice!!!

Absolutely love!! Super easy to use. Just let it dry and seal it (I used 2 coats of Out the Door) and you're good to go! I don't usually write reviews but I have been getting so many compliments on my nails. I have also done a lot of baking (and the dishes that come with it ) and they've held up really well. Love this!!

I didnt have high expectations when ordering this product due to the price being so low. i personally normally go for a Mylee or Bluesky gel polish with cost around £6-8 per bottle which i love but i thought i would give this product a go. Some of the Colours don't match 100% but that is always the case with nail polish. the Gel polish was a good consistency and applied to the nail really nicely, they have a lovely finish. i personally used a mylee base and top cost and the Gels have lasted arou

I bought this product because the reviews were promising for such a good price. I followed the instructions to the letter and the effect was barely noticeable; only a little blue appeared after drying. I applied a second coat with similar results (see photo). Not sure if other people are doing things differently but I’m not getting the rainbow effect!

reviews.t: The amount you see in the picture is literally what you get.
reviews.x: I thought it was a joke when I opened it! It’s 1/3 full, I had to go back to the order picture to see how it’s advertised. Sure enough in the picture it’s almost empty... so I guess I go what I ordered🤦🏽‍♀️. Probably won’t purchase again unless available in larger size. Probably wouldn’t get more than 3 uses out of this. I’m giving it 2 stars because it was overall my mistake but it should’ve been listed in the notes. The black polish is very sheer, so use a different black if you have one. It a

Beautiful colours, very happy with the set, I wore my first set of gel nails for around a week and there was some chipping, however regular nail varnish doesnt last on me for longer than a day so a weeks use is fine for me too, plus I want to try the other colours! The colours are beautiful and glossy. A lovely range for all year round. Definitely recommend for a starter kit. Although the bottles are smaller than regular nail varnish they will last for ages as you only need to do very thin light
So many nail designs yo choose from. I love the thermal polish. Its possibly my favorite out of this lot. The green cat eye would be a close second. Easy to apply. Great value.
I will definitely buy this product again. I’m learning how to do polygel nails, and saw this mood ring looking polish. I knew I had to have it. I wish the pot was bigger.
Love this when it works out. If found it hard to use. If you don't use the right amount of the color change liquid, it doesn't really look good.
This professional gel polish is wonderful and they use it at salons. It lasts a long time and goes on good.

Or maybe not.  I have to give Cherioll props for offering instructions on what to do with thickened product - several times. I've browsed and none of the other brands are mitigating potential issues like this. I'm goin

It says non-toxic but the black gel polish smells very bad like a toxic product. I opened it so I can not return this. If this was $10 I would be more okay lmao. But probably not going to buy again unless it’s good to use. Look at the picture I took.  Update : DONT BUY THIS PRODUCT I used it, worked for 24 hour period then the

This kit comes with everything you need to get started, besides the lamp. The colors are beautiful! I'm so in love with the teal. The polygel is so easy to work with. It's on the softer side, but not too soft. The colors change to a white when warm. I love the brush too. This is my favorite polygel brush now. The kit also comes with the top and base coat to complete your design. You also get two packs of dual forms. This is the perfect kit for beginners.

These are great value for money nails. I have stuck them on with nail bond glue, painted with uv gel polish and cured under an led lamp - they look like I’ve had them professionally done. There are enough sizes to fit everyone’s nails and there are so many in the handy numbered box that they should last for a long time. Very pleased with these nails and would definitely recommend.

reviews.t: Works nicely in a plastic modeling environment.
reviews.x: Love the colors and I love the mood changing polishes! I only said they weren’t “giftable” because you’d have to make sure the person has a UV lamp. But I love these ones! Love the glitter in them too! They really only last me about 3 days to a week. Not bad but I don’t understand why the salon has them stay on for weeks! Still love them tho! And I’d buy again!

reviews.t: 5.0 out of 5 stars Yet again, my expectations are exceeded
reviews.x: OMG!!! I saw these advertised and Instagram and immediately bought them. The colours definitely fit the theme and are well pigmented after 2 coats. Could also layer the colours with the glitter polishes. I haven’t tried the loose glitter yet but they definitely look interesting and I would recommend both this set and all collections.

Very pretty nail polish!! I love it but there was some flaws. After I showered the the polish would rehydrate and start the take off my top coats and the color with it. Than the colors would fade and turn black so I would have black spots. But besides the flaws it was totally worth it to get this nail polish.

If I could give no stars I would. I used this product 1 time last week. Went to use it again today and upon opening it the product is fully dried out. The lid was on tight yet it was still dried out. For the money I paid I got such a small amount I did not complain about but now that it’s dried out I’m mad.

reviews.t: Great for photos, not for day to day wear unfortunately.
reviews.x: Pros: The effect is super cool and lots of fun. Cons: The black gel polish itself is rather sheer and takes about 4 coats to achieve full coverage. The color change coat has a filmy finish and no matter how I did it (gel top coat, seche Vite, double UV cured THEN gel top coat), it peeled within 24-48 hours.

Love this set! I have several modelones brand gel polishes. It’s the only brand I’ll buy. It’s gorgeous and shiny even two weeks later. I also just tried the matte top coat and I love it too! I def recommend this product and the brand. I given it as a gift too.

Been having my nails done professional for years and lockdown I decided to give these a go. They are fabulous I cut them down so they are short and paint them, they last so long and they are really strong to. Will definitely buy again when I need them

Really fun to have color changing polish. The preteen and teenagers have especially loved it. Takes some practice to do on yourself and really get the designs but well worth it for how fun this is to have on your nails.

This stuff is so cool!! It is slightly thicker than typical gel polish but that actually works out well because it stays where you put it! Easy to draw designs. I drew a big heart on my nail and it turned out cute!

reviews.t: Great colors. Does not last long.
reviews.x: It is exactly as described. The colors are fantastic. Very vibrant and very reactive. It looses a star because I don't believe it was made for long term wear. After 3 days it's chipping around the edges.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the product good value and easy to use, with colors and designs they love.
Several reviewers complain that the amount of product is far less than expected, with pots arriving nearly empty.
Some reviewers report the color-changing effect is weak or hard to achieve, requiring practice or the right amount of liquid.
A few reviewers note that some colors don't match the listing exactly.
Some reviewers mention chipping or limited durability, though still acceptable for their needs.
